product.name: Monoprice Palette Series USB 2.0 USB-C to USB-A Charge and Sync Nylon-Braid Cable  6ft  White
product.description: Charge and sync your USB Type‑C® equipped mobile devices using the Palette Series of USB‑C® to Type‑A Cables. These USB 2.0 cables feature a Type‑C connector on one end and a Type‑A connector on the other end, allowing you to connect your USB‑C equipped mobile device to a Type‑A equipped wall charger, power bank, or PC connection. Available in a variety of colors, these cables support data transfer rates up to 480Mbps, as well as up to 3 amps/60 watts of charging power.                                                                                                                                                                                      Fast Charging                          Braided Jacket                          Aluminum Connectors                          Stay Synced                                              Fast Charging: These cables support up to 3 amps/60 watts of charging power, allowing you to connect your USB‑C® equipped mobile devices to Type‑A equipped car/wall chargers, PCs, and laptops.                    Braided Jacket: The nylon‑braided jacket not only helps protect the cable from nicks and cuts, but also resists tangling, making it the perfect cable for traveling.                    Aluminum Connectors: The superior structural design of the connectors are capped by aluminum connector heads, resulting in a cable that is much more durable than ordinary cables with molded connectors.
